title: a scratch HOME is the child's home on Windows too
intention: A child given a scratch HOME through home_env finds its home there on every platform: Path.home(), expanduser('~') and the instance root they imply all resolve under the scratch, so no proof's child writes into live instance space.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akiendell: with HOME=<scratch> in a child's env, Path.home() still returns C:\Users\akien, because on Windows Path.home() reads USERPROFILE and ignores HOME. cairn/tools/base/address.py:99 builds the one instance root as Path.home()/'.cairn', so every scratch-HOME child on Windows resolves the LIVE ~/.cairn. Seen landing twice: test_traces_berth_under_their_holder.py wrote fixture traces into ~/.cairn/devices/librarian/0/machines/learning_block/traces/b.jsonl (removed by hand). Census over the repo: 14 files build their scratch env through home_env, and 18 more files in 11 components copy os.environ and set HOME by hand. A proof that writes into live instance space is the severe version of a red: the run reads green or red while the live corpus quietly gains fixture records.
traces_to: 3301915df481 (home_env: a scratch HOME carries no live bus); 17d4d1899545 D7 (the leak measured on its proof); Law 3; CLAUDE.md three roots (instance space is never a proof's to write).
how: D1 home_env sets USERPROFILE beside HOME. D2 a public scratch_home_bypass(root) scan, the shape of bare_temp_reach, names hand-built HOME envs so each component holds its own proofs to the door. D3 proof test_a_scratch_home_is_the_childs_home_everywhere.py, one tooth per clause.

clauses.claim: a child run with sys.executable under home_env(scratch) prints Path.home(), os.path.expanduser('~') and cairn.tools.base.address.ROOTS['instance'], and they equal scratch, scratch and scratch/.cairn
home_env(scratch, USERPROFILE=other) gives the child USERPROFILE=other: the caller's extra still applies last
scratch_home_bypass over a testing tree with one proof that does dict(os.environ, HOME=x) and one that calls home_env(x) names exactly the first

decisions.text: D1: home_env sets env['USERPROFILE']=str(home) next to HOME, before extra is applied.

D2: scratch_home_bypass(root) -> ['<relpath>:<line> <function>'] for each function in root's proofs/test_*.py that copies os.environ and sets a HOME key; public, names no caller and exempts nothing, like bare_temp_reach.
D3: proof test_a_scratch_home_is_the_childs_home_everywhere.py, one tooth per clause, measuring only the scratch tool.

FIXME (measured 2026-11-13 on akiendell: USERPROFILE in home_env reds test_clearance.py at :103 with 5432 fe_sendauth, because the db client's passfile is read under the instance root and the scratch holds none): home_env setdefaults CAIRN_SCRATCH_BOX_INSTANCE to the caller's Path.home()/.cairn before moving HOME and USERPROFILE, so a nested scratch child still names the real box; the variable carries a path, never a secret. Clause 4 + tooth test_home_env_names_the_box_the_child_was_moved_off. The reader is ticket 6c3f73bde8fd (db client).
decisions.step: unlisted: home_env names the box the child was moved off

out: the 18 hand-built envs (each its own component's change)
